principle: Earliest inspected preprint of a named model differs from the origin of all concepts in the broader family; published journal year differs from preprint year.

sources.title: Gravitational polarization and the phenomenology of MOND
sources.inspected: Official arXiv version history and abstract; no original PDF equation-page inspection
sources.scope: Nonrelativistic gravitational-polarization/dipolar-dark-matter toy model; not a complete GR medium action

sources.title: Dipolar Particles in General Relativity
sources.inspected: Official original arXiv version history and abstract; exact GR particle action equation unreviewed
sources.scope: Pre-2008 general-relativistic dipolar-particle action and internal stabilization potential; model distinct from 2008 collective dipolar-fluid action

sources.title: Model of Dark Matter and Dark Energy Based on Gravitational Polarization
sources.inspected: Author-original arXiv abstract and publisher abstract; full action equation not source-page-inspected
sources.scope: General-relativistic model of dipolar medium; LambdaCDM-like behavior at first-order cosmological perturbations with MOND galaxy regime under weak clustering

sources.title: Dipolar dark matter and dark energy
sources.inspected: Publisher abstract and stated dependence on 2008 paper; not full PDF equation page
sources.scope: Alternative physically motivated GR matter action; should not supersede prior-year identity

sources.title: Dark Matter Superfluidity and Galactic Dynamics
sources.inspected: Author-original arXiv full HTML and journal abstract; model claims and P~rho^3 accessible, no visual equation-page review
sources.scope: Phenomenological superfluid dark matter whose phonons mediate MOND-like baryon response in certain galactic conditions

sources.title: Theory of Dark Matter Superfluidity
sources.inspected: Author original full arXiv HTML with first section and model framing; equations for full action not visually rechecked

sources.title: Galactic mass-to-light ratios with superfluid dark matter
sources.authors: Tobias Mistele; Stacy McGaugh; Sabine Hossenfelder
sources.inspected: Official arXiv first-post metadata and journal conclusion/appendix; not reproduced numerical fits

sources.title: Absence of gravitational polarization mechanism in the canonical bimetric theory
sources.authors: Luc Blanchet; Lavinia Heisenberg; François Larrouturou
sources.inspected: Publisher abstract only, not full original derivation

Do not claim later 2015 long superfluid paper predates the June 2015 short paper.
